name: Qualtrics survey SDK
plain: Survey and feedback SDK found in recent LinkedIn Android builds.
meaning: Shows in-app surveys and can attach device or session context to answers.

android.note: In Exodus 4.1.995 and 4.1.1012 reports, not in 4.1.637

limits.headline: Can show survey and feedback forms inside the LinkedIn Android app, in some versions
limits.user_action: Nothing. A survey may pop up while you use the app
can: Show survey and feedback questions inside the app
Send your survey answers over the internet
Work with no prompt after install
cannot: Appear in every version; it was in 4.1.995 and 4.1.1012 but not 4.1.637
Show up on iPhone; no evidence was found
Prove it is active; the finding comes from code scans
limits.differs: Found on Android only; no iPhone evidence.

story.what_it_is: A survey tool built into apps that pops up feedback forms.
story.for_you: You may see a small box asking how an app is doing. It can also attach details like the app version or the screen you were on, so the company can connect your answer to what you did.
story.for_makers: Makers get quick answers from real users right after a feature is used. They can send the survey only to people who just did a certain task, which makes feedback more useful.

use_cases.example: A work network app asks a rating question right after you finish writing a post.
A store app asks how checkout went just after you place an order.
A game asks how fun a new mode was after your fifth match in it.
A streaming app asks about video quality only on phones that had a buffering problem.
A bank app collects feedback after a mobile check deposit to improve the camera step.

story.android_note: Included as an app library, so it needs only the internet permission.
story.ios_note: Same library type, covered by the app's privacy label.

linkedin.how: Exodus lists a Qualtrics signature in LinkedIn Android builds from Oct 2024 on (snippets).
